title: Sanna on the Oil Rig

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: So I'm an oil rig worker now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I'm an oil rig worker now.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Well kinda. I mean I work on an Oil Rig, so I'm an Oil Rig Worker. What do you think of this place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well kinda. I mean I work on an Oil Rig, so I'm an Oil Rig Worker. What do you think of this place?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I think it's fun. What a retro idea. An oil rig! It's amazing to remember a time where all our fuel needs didn't come from water.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it's fun. What a retro idea. An oil rig! It's amazing to remember a time where all our fuel needs didn't come from water.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Something to do with DNA of extinct lifeforms? It can be used in life extending technologies with gene therapy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something to do with DNA of extinct lifeforms? It can be used in life extending technologies with gene therapy.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I mean I guess it's fine, as long as no one transforms into a dinosaur. Even then, I wouldn't mind. What dinosaur would you be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean I guess it's fine, as long as no one transforms into a dinosaur. Even then, I wouldn't mind. What dinosaur would you be?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Isn't that an ice cream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't that an ice cream?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Cool! I'd be one of the flying ones... and I'd fly the fuck out of here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cool! I'd be one of the flying ones... and I'd fly the fuck out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I've been using my cave exploration experience to train mining droids. It's been... it's been ok. Good actually. But... I might quit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been using my cave exploration experience to train mining droids. It's been... it's been ok. Good actually. But... I might quit.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Well... I know this sounds bad, but my Ex is working at a store that sells survival gear, and that same store is looking for a backroom cleaner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I know this sounds bad, but my Ex is working at a store that sells survival gear, and that same store is looking for a backroom cleaner.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: No! Well, kinda. Do you think that's a good idea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! Well, kinda. Do you think that's a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Everyone tells you that when you go through a bad break up, you need to keep your distance. But that's not working. I'm still miserable!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyone tells you that when you go through a bad break up, you need to keep your distance. But that's not working. I'm still miserable!

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Fuck that. I feel as bad today as when she dumped me. At this rate, I'll be dead before I cheer up. An afterlife as a depressed break-up ghost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck that. I feel as bad today as when she dumped me. At this rate, I'll be dead before I cheer up. An afterlife as a depressed break-up ghost.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Sure, great. Thanks for the practical advice. Very helpful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, great. Thanks for the practical advice. Very helpful.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I... haven't decided. Should I get a job right next to my Ex? I mean... probably not, right? It just hurts so bad, you know? How do you get over someone you love this much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... haven't decided. Should I get a job right next to my Ex? I mean... probably not, right? It just hurts so bad, you know? How do you get over someone you love this much?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: No really. I need to know. Give me advice. ANY advice. You've kept quiet this long, now I am asking you to speak. How do you get over a break-up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No really. I need to know. Give me advice. ANY advice. You've kept quiet this long, now I am asking you to speak. How do you get over a break-up?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Yes! Should we stay friends? Should I avoid her? Should I date someone else? Do I need to get a "revenge-body" - whatever that is. I need help!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! Should we stay friends? Should I avoid her? Should I date someone else? Do I need to get a "revenge-body" - whatever that is. I need help!

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Ok, one at a time. I have like, five questions. Maybe six. I am stuck. Just... tell me what to do. Don't spare my feelings, ok? Just tell me honestly what you think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, one at a time. I have like, five questions. Maybe six. I am stuck. Just... tell me what to do. Don't spare my feelings, ok? Just tell me honestly what you think.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I wrote her a poem. It's... pretty long. But it sets out how I really feel! I think it's important she reads it to understand my side of things. Should I send it to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wrote her a poem. It's... pretty long. But it sets out how I really feel! I think it's important she reads it to understand my side of things. Should I send it to her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe hold off till you're not feeling so raw?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe hold off till you're not feeling so raw?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe hold off till you're not feeling so raw?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe hold off till you're not feeling so raw?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Great! I'll send it to her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great! I'll send it to her.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That... might be a good idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That... might be a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Yeah... yeah.. What the fuck was I thinking? A poem? I should keep that shit to myself I reckon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... yeah.. What the fuck was I thinking? A poem? I should keep that shit to myself I reckon.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Can you be friends with your Ex? And SHOULD you be friends with your Ex?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you be friends with your Ex? And SHOULD you be friends with your Ex?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Yeah? I mean I can try, but it will be hard I guess. Because every time I see her I feel shards of glass in my chest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah? I mean I can try, but it will be hard I guess. Because every time I see her I feel shards of glass in my chest.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense. But we were good friends as well as lovers. I just wish I could keep something. Even just the friendship.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess that makes sense. But we were good friends as well as lovers. I just wish I could keep something. Even just the friendship.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That's not very helpful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not very helpful.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Cold. Blooded. But... not without appeal. I would like to "win", whatever that means.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cold. Blooded. But... not without appeal. I would like to "win", whatever that means.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Yeah. Should I get a haircut?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Should I get a haircut?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Thanks. She liked it too. In fact, we have the same hairdresser. Fuck...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. She liked it too. In fact, we have the same hairdresser. Fuck...

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah, I think you're right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... Yeah, I think you're right.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That's extreme... but I could do with some new clothes. A new look. Maybe another piercing? I dunno...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's extreme... but I could do with some new clothes. A new look. Maybe another piercing? I dunno...

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Second last question... Do I tell her I'm happy for her. Do I... forgive her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Second last question... Do I tell her I'm happy for her. Do I... forgive her?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: For cheating on me with Zack. For lying to me. For breaking my fucking heart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For cheating on me with Zack. For lying to me. For breaking my fucking heart.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I think I need more time before I can forgive her. Maybe never. And fuck Zack! This is all his fault.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I need more time before I can forgive her. Maybe never. And fuck Zack! This is all his fault.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That.. makes a lot of sense actually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That.. makes a lot of sense actually.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Maybe, but that's not really what I want to hear now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe, but that's not really what I want to hear now.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Right!? Fucking asshole.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right!? Fucking asshole.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Should I leave? Run away from all of this? Once the LUZ lifts, I could go to another district, or to the Eastern Peninsula. I could disappear to the Ventz, or try to hitch a ride to Luna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should I leave? Run away from all of this? Once the LUZ lifts, I could go to another district, or to the Eastern Peninsula. I could disappear to the Ventz, or try to hitch a ride to Luna.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Exactly. If my problems are behind me, then to face them I have to go backwards. Maybe I just keep running till they disappear in the rear-view mirror.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. If my problems are behind me, then to face them I have to go backwards. Maybe I just keep running till they disappear in the rear-view mirror.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That's so banal and depressing it's probably true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's so banal and depressing it's probably true.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That makes sense. Maybe I need to think less about what I've lost and more about what I could gain. Like... I could get some beer and a grilled cheese if I went back to my mom's district.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That makes sense. Maybe I need to think less about what I've lost and more about what I could gain. Like... I could get some beer and a grilled cheese if I went back to my mom's district.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: *sigh* I don't know. I need to think. And I need to sleep. I'm just over a twelve hour shift. Hey... thanks for listening. I mean it. It really helped. I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *sigh* I don't know. I need to think. And I need to sleep. I'm just over a twelve hour shift. Hey... thanks for listening. I mean it. It really helped. I think.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Whoa. Seriously? Like, I need help here. You won't listen at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa. Seriously? Like, I need help here. You won't listen at all?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Great. Thanks for everything. You're the best...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great. Thanks for everything. You're the best...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's impressive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's impressive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's depressing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's depressing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is oil used for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is oil used for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds exciting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds exciting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds creepy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds creepy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A T-Rex?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A T-Rex?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A triceratops?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A triceratops?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A Stracciatella?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Stracciatella?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, that is definitely a dinosaur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, that is definitely a dinosaur.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, that is definitely a dinosaur.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, that is definitely a dinosaur.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your job here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your job here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're keeping an eye on your Ex?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're keeping an eye on your Ex?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're keeping an eye on your Ex?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're keeping an eye on your Ex?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It takes time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It takes time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you need to stop feeling sorry for yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you need to stop feeling sorry for yourself.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you need to stop feeling sorry for yourself.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you need to stop feeling sorry for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you leaving the Oil Rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you leaving the Oil Rig?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you leaving the Oil Rig?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you leaving the Oil Rig?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really want my advice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really want my advice?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where do I start?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do I start?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, that might help her understand your feelings better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, that might help her understand your feelings better.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, that might help her understand your feelings better.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, that might help her understand your feelings better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No! A million times no. Keep that to yourself. Write it in your notes app or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! A million times no. Keep that to yourself. Write it in your notes app or something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No! A million times no. Keep that to yourself. Write it in your notes app or something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No! A million times no. Keep that to yourself. Write it in your notes app or something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Next question?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Next question?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, you can be friends. If you stay on good terms, that's a good goal to aim for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, you can be friends. If you stay on good terms, that's a good goal to aim for.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure, you can be friends. If you stay on good terms, that's a good goal to aim for.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure, you can be friends. If you stay on good terms, that's a good goal to aim for.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. Your goal is to separate cleanly. Friendships can follow later when you've gotten over your Ex.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Your goal is to separate cleanly. Friendships can follow later when you've gotten over your Ex.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. Your goal is to separate cleanly. Friendships can follow later when you've gotten over your Ex.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. Your goal is to separate cleanly. Friendships can follow later when you've gotten over your Ex.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe. It depends on where you both are emotionally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. It depends on where you both are emotionally.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe. It depends on where you both are emotionally.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe. It depends on where you both are emotionally.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, your Ex is your enemy. Your goal is to beat them by doing better than them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, your Ex is your enemy. Your goal is to beat them by doing better than them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, your Ex is your enemy. Your goal is to beat them by doing better than them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, your Ex is your enemy. Your goal is to beat them by doing better than them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's still three more questions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's still three more questions?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your hair looks great as it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your hair looks great as it is.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your hair looks great as it is.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your hair looks great as it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, change your style up. It's good for you to make some positive changes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, change your style up. It's good for you to make some positive changes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, change your style up. It's good for you to make some positive changes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, change your style up. It's good for you to make some positive changes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Change everything. Clothes. Hair. Consider surgery, or some new neural augments to change your voice or make you funnier or more charming.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Change everything. Clothes. Hair. Consider surgery, or some new neural augments to change your voice or make you funnier or more charming.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Change everything. Clothes. Hair. Consider surgery, or some new neural augments to change your voice or make you funnier or more charming.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Change everything. Clothes. Hair. Consider surgery, or some new neural augments to change your voice or make you funnier or more charming.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What next?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What next?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For leaving you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For leaving you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cheating is always wrong. Never forgive. Remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cheating is always wrong. Never forgive. Remember.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Cheating is always wrong. Never forgive. Remember.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Cheating is always wrong. Never forgive. Remember.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Holding a grudge is like holding anything. Drop it, and you'll feel lighter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Holding a grudge is like holding anything. Drop it, and you'll feel lighter.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Holding a grudge is like holding anything. Drop it, and you'll feel lighter.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Holding a grudge is like holding anything. Drop it, and you'll feel lighter.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't owe her forgiveness. You can move on, but you don't need to forgive her to do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't owe her forgiveness. You can move on, but you don't need to forgive her to do that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't owe her forgiveness. You can move on, but you don't need to forgive her to do that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't owe her forgiveness. You can move on, but you don't need to forgive her to do that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It takes two to cheat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It takes two to cheat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He was out of line.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He was out of line.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your last question?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your last question?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Running away from your problems is underrated. What if they never catch you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Running away from your problems is underrated. What if they never catch you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Running away from your problems is underrated. What if they never catch you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Running away from your problems is underrated. What if they never catch you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Running away is never the answer. You have to face your problems.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Running away is never the answer. You have to face your problems.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Running away is never the answer. You have to face your problems.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Running away is never the answer. You have to face your problems.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't run AWAY from things here... but if there is something you want to run TO, maybe now is the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't run AWAY from things here... but if there is something you want to run TO, maybe now is the time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't run AWAY from things here... but if there is something you want to run TO, maybe now is the time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't run AWAY from things here... but if there is something you want to run TO, maybe now is the time.

nodes.text: So what are you going to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what are you going to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what are you going to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bye.

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll try to help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.
